title: Tempo by Hilton Lifestyle Brand to Debut in Germany with Hotel at MUNICH ARENA
summary: Hilton announced the signing of the 199‑room Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena, which will open on the MUNICH ARENA campus in 2029.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Set to open in 2029, Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena will become one of Europe’s first hotels under Hilton’s expanding lifestyle brand


- **199-room Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena is set to open in 2029 on the MUNICH ARENA campus**
- **The signing marks the debut of the Tempo by Hilton brand in Germany**
- **The hotel will feature purposefully designed rooms, wellness-focused amenities, a ground-floor café and a rooftop bar.**


**MUNICH, Germany** –[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the signing of the 199-room Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena, which will open on the MUNICH ARENA campus in 2029, alongside the arena itself.


This milestone signing marks the debut of the Tempo by Hilton brand in Germany, joining 86 properties trading and pipeline under the brand, including European signings in Belfast City Centre, Lisbon Parque das Nações, and Reykjavik.


Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena - Reception - Credit MUNICH ARENA Group


Thorsten Faasch, managing director, development, DACH, Hilton, said, “Germany has been a key market for Hilton for more than 50 years, and we’re thrilled to bring Tempo by Hilton to the country for the first time. As part of our expanding lifestyle portfolio, Tempo delivers a stylish, contemporary experience designed for active travellers, with purposefully designed rooms and wellness focused amenities. Strategically located at one of Europe’s busiest transport hubs and next to the new concert arena, the hotel offers exceptional convenience for travellers.”


Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena forms part of the live entertainment campus of MUNICH ARENA, a landmark destination set to become one of Europe’s premier concert venues and to bring world-class live entertainment to Munich. For guests, the energy of live events, the architectural character of MUNICH ARENA and the convenience of a major international travel hub come together in one place. After the last song, the evening continues on the campus.


Lorenz Schmid, managing partner, MUNICH ARENA, said, “For us, everything begins with the music. We have been developing MUNICH ARENA for the best possible live entertainment experience from the very first sketch, and every decision is measured against one question: what does world-class live entertainment need? A hotel on the campus is part of that answer. After the last song, the evening continues on site. Fans, artists and crews stay where the music happens. We are delighted that Tempo by Hilton is coming to the MUNICH ARENA campus, and we look forward to the moment the first concert begins.”


Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena - Guest Room - Credit MUNICH ARENA Group


At Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena, thoughtful design supports how guests prepare, recharge and connect throughout their stay. Each room features a dedicated ‘ Get Ready Zone’ - a well-lit area equipped with a vanity mirror, custom desk, and open wardrobe - providing guests with a functional space to prepare for the day. The hotel’ s fully equipped gym with cardio, a weights section, and recovery area brings the brand’s signature ‘Power Up’ experience to life. Additional highlights include a ground-floor café offering a variety of nourishing food and beverage options to energise or unwind, and a rooftop bar serving craft cocktails and small plates in a relaxed setting.


Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena is signed through a management agreement with Allresto Munich Airport Hotel and Restaurants GmbH, a subsidiary of Munich Airport. Allresto has leased the hotel from SWMUNICH Accomodation GmbH, part of MUNICH ARENA group.


Andreas Reichert, managing director, Allresto Munich Airport Hotel and Restaurants GmbH, said, “We are excited to be once again collaborating with Hilton, particularly as this marks a first for the Tempo by Hilton brand in Germany. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership with Hilton and, with this new hotel, contributing to the further growth of the area surrounding the MUNICH ARENA.”


Munich Airport is one of Germany’s busiest international airports and a major hub for domestic and international flights, with more than 43 million passengers in 2025. Munich itself is one of Europe’s most dynamic cities, home to seven DAX-listed corporations and known for its rich cultural life and strong international profile.


Guests at Tempo by Hilton Munich Airport Arena will benefit from Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest loyalty program for Hilton’s 28 world-class brands. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits, including a flexible payment slider that allows members to choose nearly any combination of Points and money to book a stay, an exclusive member discount that can’t be found anywhere else and free standard Wi-Fi. Members also have access to contactless technology exclusively through the industry-leading Hilton Honors mobile app, where Hilton Honors members can check-in, choose their room and access their room using Digital Key.

## About MUNICH ARENA


MUNICH ARENA is a planned concert arena at Munich Airport with a capacity of approximately 20,000 fans. Developed as a venue dedicated to live music and part of a long-term strategic partnership with Live Nation, the world’s leading live entertainment company, its architecture, technical infrastructure, audience areas and backstage facilities are being designed around acoustics, sightlines, fan experience and the requirements of international touring productions. Sustainability is an integral part of the overall concept, bringing architecture, technology, operations and experience together over the long term. MUNICH ARENA is the first dedicated concert arena in Europe to receive a Gold pre-certificate from the German Sustainable Building Council (DGNB). An economic impact analysis by Deloitte forecasts gross value added of approximately EUR 350 million per year during operation, including indirect and induced effects, and approximately EUR 390 million during the planning and construction phase.
